chapter: Chicago memories and the road to the Navy
title: The dog Bring Down bought at Westchester
summary: Marge says Bring Down is named for spending six of ten dollars on the dog when she needed the rent; Zutty bought him while playing at Westchester with Hawk, Hot Lips, Pee Wee and Fats.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: But 'bring down', when anything was a bring down that was, they didn't use drag in those days. When Zutty told me he had paid seven dollars for the dog out of ten dollars and I was depending on it for the rent. And I said, seven, I got him for sixty one, and I said, boy is that a bring down. And Zutty said, that's your name, 'Bring Down'.
And he only had made ten dollars that night and I was going to use that for our room rent. and I...
Marge said, six out of that ten? Because that's when we were playing up at Westchester.
And I had warned Zutty not to spend any of it.
(unintelligible) and all that crowd you know. Hawk and Hot Lips, Peewee and Joe Sullivan, Fats and oh.....
She's out in California isn't she?
No, she's in Louisville. She was looking after her father now I don't know whether she still does. Well we've got to get out, we've got to finish New Orleans. What about the Cadillac then?
